decisive_spans.text: compound heterozygous sequence variation in GGCX gene
Low clotting activity of factor X (52.2%; reference range, 77%-131%)
Prolonged prothrombin time (12.8 seconds; reference range, 10.4-12.6 seconds)

response.rationale: The patient's genetic testing results, specifically the compound heterozygous sequence variation in the GGCX gene, directly support GGCX deficiency. Additionally, the low clotting activity of factor X and prolonged prothrombin time are consistent with the role of GGCX in vitamin K-dependent coagulation factors. While Pseudoxanthoma elasticum (D5) is supported by the skin findings, it does not account for the coagulation abnormalities or the genetic findings.
